instruction: I want to limit the maximum volume in VLC to 200% instead of the default. I sometimes accidentally increase the volume too much and it causes distortion. How can I set a volume limit?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the maximum volume limit in VLC to 200%. The evaluator checks the VLC config file for qt-max-volume setting, expecting it to be set to 200. This uses the existing check_qt_max_volume metric function.
